study.question: Can deterministic target-match partitions retain learned event-value information lost by a single mean, while bypassing the per-event neural attention scorer? Does true event membership matter beyond group size, occupancy and readout width?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g1-r0004-mean_match AUC .616519 is .000608 below g1-r0002-joint_count .617127, while train time falls from 499.38 to 476.37 seconds and peak bytes from 654562816 to 434576896. Content-only weighting (.616497) did not close the gap. Learned values matter: g1-r0003-count_summary .613095 versus mean_match .616519. Explicit matching also matters: mean_activity .610216. Provisional mechanism: one global mean mixes matching-event action/recency/value content with background; four disjoint target-match means expose conditional content without an event scoring MLP. These are single-seed observations and an untested explanation, not confirmed causality.

nearest_work.difference: Primary archived arxiv:1706.06978v4, content SHA256 5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2, lines 232-277, read in this turn. Inherits embedding/pooling/MLP and target-conditioned history motivation. Uses four hard bucket-equality partitions and uniform means rather than learned per-event activation. Original DIN explicitly drops softmax to retain intensity; the local reference uses softmax plus direct counts, so neither it nor this suite is exact DIN reproduction. Hard grouping is not claimed globally novel; broader nearest-work coverage remains incomplete.

Author README at commit 2c6e76804281954a3c969010a31712cd5054aca9, lines 4-8, confirms category/brand/type histories without item IDs. Publisher paper inaccessible in supplied registry; no detailed DMR mechanism comparison or reproduction claim.

Source 633247fc118a1e2430bb887be97873aa3b35102dba6eb501dfdc1bac42ef7959 inspected. Same trainable sum-valued events and direct counts; replaces a single d-dimensional mean with four d-dimensional conditional means. Expanded first head layer adds 6144 parameters at default dimensions; new matched controls share that expansion.

Current candidate.py source inspected before edit. Keeps exact match/count formulas, embeddings, action, age buckets and dormant scorer allocation. Routes values by event match status rather than learned scalar weights.

study.proposed_difference: Replace the single learned or mean history vector by four concatenated means in fixed order: neither target field matches, category only, brand only, both fields on the same event. Exclude zero IDs from matches and zero empty groups. Three standalone modules differ only in literal grouping_mode: match, rank, occupied_global. rank assigns valid-event input ranks into groups with the EXACT true per-example group cardinalities. occupied_global repeats the global mean in each occupied true group and zeroes empty groups. Same N,C,B,J slots remain. Rank is a deterministic positional replacement, not randomized matching; its potential position/recency effects remain explicit. No event IDs, host code or information boundary changes.
predictions: Predeclared primary contrasts: match > rank and match > occupied_global on full validation AUC. A direction is promising at delta >= .0003 against BOTH controls, with no Logloss increase above .0001; thresholds guide follow-up only, not significance.

Efficiency target versus g1-r0002-joint_count: AUC within .0003 or better, with at least 15% lower measured peak GPU bytes. Report training seconds, end-to-end inference time and p50/p95 even if they do not improve. Parameter count alone does not establish equal compute.

Source invariants: rank and true group counts/occupancy exactly match; disjoint match/rank groups cover each valid event once. Size-weighted match/rank pools reconstruct the global mean. Occupied_global exposes the same occupancy and global content but no conditional membership.

Predeclared subgroup comparison uses host category_match_present (2516922 samples; 129821 positive, 2387101 negative) and absent (717129; 29616 positive, 687513 negative); history_gt64 (3026583; 151372 positive, 2875211 negative) versus shorter slices. Report all host slices/counts; no posthoc bin changes. Semantic conditional-content benefit should concentrate where groups are mixed, but host categories are imperfect proxies. First-512 diagnostics are exploratory and cannot establish population support.
falsifiers: If match fails to beat either size-matched rank or occupancy/global control, semantic membership explanation lacks controlled support, even if it beats an older narrower reference.

If all expanded variants improve similarly, head width, occupancy/normalization or optimization is a viable explanation. If match cannot retain quality at a measured resource benefit, this implementation does not support efficient replacement.
Nonzero partition/count/padding invariant errors or nonfinite/shape-invalid outputs invalidate the corresponding trial; retain failed cost and repair before any scientific comparison.

A null or negative result refutes neither all target-aware grouping nor the external architectures. Three-seed paired replication and user-cluster uncertainty remain necessary before a reliability claim.
alternative_explanations: Earlier action grouping (.611913 versus interleaved .613042) and field_values (.613185 versus collapsed_values .613311) failed to improve their controls. Finer representation alone has not worked. Joint versus independent counts (.617127 versus .617123) also leaves joint event dependence unsupported. Counts versus rates (.617127 versus .614756) implicated scale/activity, not necessarily joint structure.

Four means add 6144 dense weights and change head initialization relative to the parent; identical allocation across new controls addresses allocated capacity but effective input rank and gradients still differ.

Empty-group flags and normalization can reveal intensity; counts already encode exact group sizes, but ease of learning can differ. The occupied-global control preserves occupancy and per-slot zeroing.

Rank groups preserve sizes but impose input-position structure; they are not exchangeable random groups or a pure causal intervention. Small group means have high variance and bucket collisions/missing brand IDs can distort semantics.
A .000608 validation gap is one initialization, not a significance result. Repeated adaptive use of validation, snapshot as-of uncertainty and fixed 128-event truncation limit generalization.

Review of latest declared industry use: prior query removal and attention simplification did not recover parent AUC. The new suite is driven by this unresolved local gap, not evidence that an industry system transfers.
